representation: Rust facade contract description; not a general JSON codec
semantics: Value::bit_eq compares exact f64 bits, distinguishing signed zero and preserving NaN payload identity.
Nonfinite Real values are representable; operation-specific parameter/time/domain validation still applies.
Value::Enum can carry an invalid class/ordinal; operation boundaries validate against registered descriptors. No universal validity guarantee from construction.
No new generic JSON/wire value codec. Catalog enum kinds instead include canonical class path and ordered member names.

types.ConnectorId: u32 dense model-local index, not durable or host identity

Enum.class: model-local EnumClassId retained in Value and ValueType
Enum.ordinal: u32, one-based in registered class declaration order

Value.Integer: i64 signed carrier; CDL requires at least the 32-bit domain
